sources.fact: LBBD60/DP Former Abbey Retail Park is 2.1ha, 1,089 net dwellings, permissioned with full planning permission dated 7 January 2020 and notes Development commenced.
Planning Committee considered exact application 18/02013/FUL for phased redevelopment providing 1,089 dwellings plus commercial/employment/community uses.
Separate Crown House evidence is not reused for DP; case identity remains tied to Abbey Retail Park application references only.
21/02087/VAR varies the 18/02013/FUL consent and records the approved 1,089-dwelling scheme, with amendments to ground floor/non-residential arrangements and conditions.

23/01915/VAR concerns later changes; committee material states extant affordable units in Phases 1 and 2 were under construction/occupied and the proposal sought additional residential units alongside fire-safety design changes.
The 2024 variation is treated as a separate proposal/decision scope and does not silently overwrite the current Brownfield register count of 1,089.
The adopted Local Plan retains Former Abbey Retail Park as a housing-led allocation; allocation context is separate from planning-decision scope.
Development-plan policy context does not replace exact consent/variation evidence.
The Brownfield register is authoritative-source current register evidence; its dwelling count is not rewritten from a proposal without verified authoritative update.
Exact planning decisions and variations are kept by reference; case-specific status is not inferred from scheme name alone.
Point/register discovery is not converted into an exact HMLR title relation or application red-line.
Brownfield evidence is planning-site register context and is not a substitute for title/parcel evidence.

examples.result: DP current Brownfield count remains 1,089 and permissioned/commenced.
18/02013/FUL is the exact main consent reference for the 1,089-dwelling scheme.
21/02087/VAR is retained as a later variation, not a separate unrelated candidate.
23/01915/VAR later-phase changes are not automatically converted into a new Brownfield dwelling total.
Phases 1 and 2 under-construction/occupied evidence does not prove the whole 1,089 scheme is complete.
Scheme-name similarity with other Barking projects is not used for application binding.
Permission/commencement does not establish exact HMLR parcel relation for canonical candidate rows.
Promotion remains zero until exact title/site polygon and current statutory overlays are executed.
